title: kbingest map's machine-name check takes the environment user and lets a short host name inside a longer value pass
goal: machine_names reads the passwd user as well as the environment's (pwd.getpwuid, guarded for Windows) and compares the first label of a dot-split value, so a host name shorter than four characters inside an FQDN is left out of the map; a test plants each; found in the review of SP-eqmblr7t (BG-lv7oszlp)
repro_reason: the fix adds a lookup the host decides; a planted user and host are the item's own test, still to be written, and the repro reads the source until it exists
